title: BioGDR predicts cell-line sensitivity to an ALDH1B1 inhibitor
summary: BioGDR combines molecular structure with learned, predicted gene-expression and kinase-effect features and transcriptomic cell representations. Prospective in-vitro tests confirmed differential sensitivity to Golgicide A-2, including T84 colorectal cells (reported IC50 1.09 μM). This is a cell-line sensitivity result, not evidence of clinical benefit or discovery of the compound itself.
ai_technology: BioGDR multimodal interpretable deep learning; pathway graph attention
organization: Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and clinical benefit are not established by this source review.
evidence.ai_role: The model integrates predicted compound effects and cell transcriptomes to rank drug responses; the study prospectively tests candidate sensitivity in cell lines.
